name: fi-property-transfer-tax
description: Calculate Finnish transfer tax on direct real estate, buildings and housing or real-estate-company shares acquired in 2026. Establish the taxable consideration, property-company debt and ownership percentage before applying the statutory rate. Covers signing versus ownership-transfer deadlines, private and agent-assisted transactions, new construction, foreign buyers, indirect property interests, earnout consideration under the 2026 amendment, corrections, refunds and statutory late-filing sanctions. Trigger on varainsiirtovero, debt-free price, housing shares, property purchase, additional consideration or title registration. Annual real-estate tax is a separate liability, while rental income and disposal gains belong in the individual or corporate income-tax computation.
